posts.trend: Woman says ‘don’t come’ to Bangalore if you earn less than Rs 1 lakh a month, cites high rent and property
posts.context: Finance influencers and viral threads tell people how to budget down to the last rupee, ignoring that simple survival is priced out.
posts.angle: The advice industry suggests the solution to high prices is to stop having physical needs.
slides: Financial advice for your thirty-first year.

posts.caption: This is for the friend who has three personal finance podcasts in their library and still borrows ₹500 before payday. 📉
